title: AFS Global STEM Academies
about: AFS Global STEM Academies is a scholarship programme for students aged 15 to 17.5 from eligible countries, including Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Mexico and South Africa. It is taught in English and includes international travel.
requirements: Nationality/citizenship or legal residence in Azerbaijan, Brazil, Egypt, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, South Africa, Trinidad & Tobago or the United Kingdom (per the official page)
Aged 15 to 17.5 years at the program start date
Able to follow a program taught entirely in English and to travel internationally for the full four weeks
